prompt: How am I going to get all of this into my head?
title: A quick note on reading
text: You can select text anywhere on your screen. Lilt keeps the original layout and reads it aloud, highlighting each word as it goes. Click a word to jump to that part. The controls appear when you move your pointer over the reading, and disappear when you move away.
endTitle: Listen to what’s on your screen.
endDetail: Lilt for macOS · Free and open source
